stem: The range of the function $f(x) = \dfrac{3}{1 + \lvert x \rvert}$ is ( )
solution: Since $\lvert x \rvert \ge 0$, the denominator satisfies $1 + \lvert x \rvert \ge 1$, so $0 < f(x) \le \dfrac{3}{1} = 3$. The largest value $3$ is reached at $x = 0$. As $\lvert x \rvert$ grows, $f(x)$ comes as close to $0$ as we like, but it is never $0$. So the range is $(0, 3]$.
